prerequisites: Fundamentos de Informática (Fundamentals of Computer Science)
Basic English language skills for technical documentation

learning_outcomes.text: List and describe technologies for information processing
Understand information representation systems oriented towards the exploitation of telematic services
Describe multimedia information processing and storage technologies
Specify the functions of devices and interfaces for multimedia information capture and presentation
Describe interfaces for multimedia information transport

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the work environment and digital information
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 50% from the theoretical part (NTeo) and 50% from the practical part (NPrac). NTeo is composed of three partial theoretical controls (40/3% each) and a final theoretical control (60%). NPrac is composed of two partial practical controls (25% each) and a group work (50%). A minimum score of 50% in both NTeo and NPrac is required to pass the subject; otherwise, the final grade will be the lower of 4.5 points and the calculated grade. Fraudulent activity in any assessment will result in a 0 for the corresponding attempt and may lead to other sanctions.
